arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

fmt = 'fixed-point: {:f}\nfloating-point: {:e}'
text = '''fixed-point: 100.2345
floating-point: 1.1e-10'''

p = parse.Parser(fmt)
print('Fixed fields:', p._fixed_fields)
m = p._search_re.search(text)
if m:
    print('Number of groups:', len(m.groups()))
    for i in range(len(m.groups())):
        print(f'Group {i}: {m.group(i)!r}')
"
